v124_1CapabilityInventory.outcome: Open, compare, merge, and project every verified replay branch from exact sealed sources without a database or last-write-wins collapse.
v124_1CapabilityInventory.authorityBoundary: Each sealed replay source is verified independently. Family and branch projections coordinate exact admitted sources but never replace the enclosing proof objects.

v124_1CapabilityInventory.outcome: Compose direct or unlimited invited-member conversations from complete causal history, bounded retrieval windows, encrypted epoch grants, and exact Receiz-ID participant bindings.
v124_1CapabilityInventory.authorityBoundary: Receiz identity bindings and sealed conversation events remain authority. MCP returns safe coordinates and encrypted grant envelopes only; clear messages and epoch secrets stay in trusted-host custody.

v124_1CapabilityInventory.outcome: Build, publish, hold, reopen, and reconstruct inline RMA2 or segmented RMC1/RMC2 with raw RMA3 projection while verifying the enclosing artifact before native media use.
v124_1CapabilityInventory.authorityBoundary: Transport segments, locators, manifests, object URLs, and storage are projections only. Native bytes are admitted only beneath verification of the enclosing sealed artifact.

v124_1CapabilityInventory.outcome: Start verified first-frame playback from signed range commitments while remaining ranges settle behind the already playing media.
v124_1CapabilityInventory.authorityBoundary: Only a progressive ledger whose complete root is carried by the enclosing Signature-V4 proof can authorize range projection. Unsigned offsets, container metadata, or transport segments cannot.

v124_1CapabilityInventory.primitive: event-derived proof memory and non-authoritative Twin response
v124_1CapabilityInventory.outcome: Resolve complete proof history through bounded cognition windows, cite exact proof objects, and generate local or connected Twin speech without promoting model output into fact or command authority.
v124_1CapabilityInventory.authorityBoundary: Proof-derived memory cites admitted events and exact primary proof objects. Twin speech, summaries, intent, and performance remain non-authoritative proposals until deterministic command admission accepts a consequential action.

v124_1CapabilityInventory.outcome: Seal, verify, and immediately project complete account truth—including profile, showcase, wallet, market positions/history, media, and proof history—without waiting on a server or database.
v124_1CapabilityInventory.authorityBoundary: The verified Identity Seal, Identity Record, or Receiz Key carries account truth. Private portable state is not exposed through MCP; server synchronization may append verified additions only after immediate local projection.

v125CapabilityInventory.outcome: Any developer architecture can reverify a completed portable execution-authority transition, admit the resulting lawful sealed action, and derive its one canonical current-owner Settlement membership without declaring completion, Phi, or institutional approval.
v125CapabilityInventory.authorityBoundary: The enclosing sealed artifact, reverified portable execution-authority transition, and canonical lawful-action append remain authority. Actor, subject head, causal parents, commitments, witness, and Kai coordinates are derived from verified completion. A developer, MCP host, server, database, institution, or projection cannot declare completion or supply or redefine derived Phi.

v125CapabilityInventory.outcome: External applications can plan, verify, commit, transport, send, and receive explicit Settlement or Reserve at the two user edges while servers perform additive global sync only.
v125CapabilityInventory.authorityBoundary: The exact sealed proof objects, verified transition set, and SDK-issued committed transitions carry the transaction at the sender and receiver edges. MCP references are custody mechanics; servers and databases only synchronize the resulting proof globally.

v125CapabilityInventory.outcome: Any domain can define claims, verify sealed evidence, run an exact-head attestation history, issue a portable credential, and resolve append-only lifecycle currentness without making an application database, institution, or embedded self-hash the authority.
v125CapabilityInventory.authorityBoundary: The verified enclosing domain-authority, evidence, attestation, and credential proof objects plus their exact accepted heads remain authority. SDK, MCP, AI, database, institution, and display projections cannot grant roles, invent evidence, or rewrite lifecycle history.

v125CapabilityInventory.outcome: A holder can reveal only public and consented selective claims, prove each disclosure against the credential claim root, and separately prove live PBI/Receiz-ID presence for the exact verifier, presentation, consent, and accepted head.
v125CapabilityInventory.authorityBoundary: The sealed credential, exact accepted lifecycle head, claim-root witnesses, and PBI/Receiz-ID authorship proof remain authority. Presentation containers and transport references are not credential, identity, or currentness authority.

v125CapabilityInventory.outcome: Receiz subjects append relationships and explicit expiring presence to complete sealed sources, retain their complete source families, and derive consent-filtered discovery from exact verified heads. Closed presence declarations exclude precise-coordinate fields. Source-bound thread plan/apply supports the close effect with atomic participant-head checks and PBI consumption; encrypted message effects remain unsupported.
v125CapabilityInventory.authorityBoundary: Sealed subject proof and exact consent/relationship/presence heads remain authority. Discovery indexes, sessions, databases, devices, and model-visible projections may filter or locate but cannot create identity, consent, relationship, or presence truth.

v125CapabilityInventory.outcome: Payment, refund, notification, and other external actions use one typed exact-head execution law with deterministic planning, explicit confirmation, terminal outcomes, exact retry identity, and provider evidence that never becomes authority.
v125CapabilityInventory.authorityBoundary: The sealed plan, exact proof heads, explicit confirmation, and accepted terminal outcome append remain authority. A provider response, webhook, durable handle, server, database, MCP result, or AI output is evidence or representation only.
